title: 区分一般过去式与不规则过去分词

targetSkill.canDo: 在现在完成时语境中选择并使用常见不规则动词的过去分词。

sourceEvidence.prompt: Mina has ___ (write) three short notes about saving water this week.

recognition.text: Mina has wrote three short notes about saving water this week.

competingHypotheses.description: 学生知道动作发生在过去，但把一般过去式 wrote 当成过去分词 written。
学生尚未稳定理解 has/have 与过去分词共同表达的结构和语义。

intervention.explanation: 先根据时间和助动词判断结构，再分别提取 took 与 taken，而不是只记住动作发生在过去。
steps: 圈出 has/have 和时间线索。
判断需要一般过去式还是过去分词。
用一组新动词完成对比练习。

d1.prompt: The class has ___ (choose) a new monitor.

d7.prompt: Correct the verb form: Amy has went to the library twice this month.
d7.answer: Amy has gone to the library twice this month.
